Name: (CP) Shardust's Pastel Recolors - Wizard Catalogue Furniture
Author: Shardust
Description:
[center][size=5][b][color=#e06666]Shardust's Pastel Recolors - Wizard Catalogue Furniture[/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][color=#efefef][size=5]A Pastel recolor of the Wizard Catalogue Furniture. 
Been working on this for a while, though it needs a bit more tweaking before I'm fully satisfied, but it's good enough for publishing. Plus, I didn't want to miss the Stardew Modfest badge, ahah![/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#e06666][size=5][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#efefef][size=5]Simply add it to the mod folder. :D[/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#e06666][size=5][b]Main features[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#efefef][size=5]Adds pastel recolor options to all the furniture pieces in the Wizard Catalogue. Some have a set color, others can be changed either partially or fully. 
[i](Will be updated later on with more color options :D)[/i][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#e06666][size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#efefef][size=5]The best way to use the mod is to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to edit the colors directly in-game. [/size][/color][/center]
